title: F12 narrow docs draft updates and replacement fences
proofLimits: Trusted authored form-workflow data only. No persistence, validator service, model or authorization runtime is started. Disposable consumer callbacks use fixed 1500ms timers solely to exercise asynchronous feedback.
First ten cases use real official-SDK nested frames; last two use direct docs consumers to isolate local-draft preservation and same-root replacement fences from iframe remounts.

Raw form/region DOM records native values, constraints, JSON disclosures, reported progress, child SECTION busy/alerts, focused summaries/headings and lifetime callback counters. Producer alerts remain distinct from the exact consumer-callback error.

Host editor payloads describe invocation data; local edits and controlled navigation do not rewrite that editor. Explicit form submit/commit intents contain reviewed supplied values or differences; navigation and reported-state inspection carry identity only.

Pinned SDK console classification is fatal on any unclassified send. No tools/context/message request, download, cookie or browser permission is allowed. Every ordinary request must be owned-origin GET and completely acknowledged.

Chromium narrow touch is emulation, not physical-device or exhaustive accessibility/untrusted-HTML proof. Browser HTTP completion is not raw socket EOF or every-asset integrity; process teardown belongs to the supervisor.
